_about: Heading regexes used by locate_results_sections.py, documented in skills/results-filing-layouts/references/section-headings.md. Case-insensitive, matched against one line or two joined lines of page text. 'needs_numbers' sections are accepted only on a page with at least min_numeric_tokens number-like tokens, because the auditor's report and the covering letter quote the statement titles in running prose.

headings.regex: independent auditor'?s'?\s+(limited\s+)?(review\s+)?report|limited review report|auditor'?s'? report on (the )?(quarterly|annual|standalone|consolidated|audited|unaudited|financial)|report on the audit of the|review report to the board

statement of\s+((un-?audited|audited|standalone|consolidated|reviewed)\s+(and\s+)?)*financial results|(un-?audited|audited)\s+((standalone|consolidated)\s+)?financial results for the|statement of (standalone |consolidated )?profit (and|&) loss
statement of\s+((un-?audited|audited|standalone|consolidated)\s+)*assets (and|&) liabilities|(standalone |consolidated )?balance sheet as at|(standalone|consolidated)\s+statement of assets
statement of (material )?deviations?( or |/| and )?variations?|statement of utili[sz]ation of (issue )?proceeds|statement indicating (the )?utili[sz]ation
disclosure of related party transactions|related party transactions for the (half[- ]year|six months)

letter_cues: dear sir|dear madam|\bsub(ject)?\s*[:.-]|scrip code|\bsymbol\s*[:.-]|bse limited|national stock exchange|listing department|corporate relationship|phiroze jeejeebhoy|exchange plaza|yours (faithfully|sincerely|truly)
